objective: Update the machine's official DeepSeek Harness CLI/runtime to npm @latest without changing persistent official user state, verify the official web Harness remains healthy, and collect bounded runtime/version evidence for the dsh-crew v0.3 release compatibility audit.
context: The user explicitly authorizes uninstall/reinstall/update of the official DeepSeek Harness CLI/runtime if needed. Preserve persistent official state under ~/.dsh (profiles, settings, credentials, sessions); never print, copy, migrate, or commit credential values. Keep dsh-crew's separate Crew-owned runtime/profile under ~/.config/dsh-crew/harness unchanged. Resolve npm @latest dynamically at execution time and do not install @next unless npm has promoted that exact version to @latest.
forbidden_changes: repository source, existing tests, package.json, lockfile, CI, release or tag files
credential values or other secrets in repository files, logs, or the Result Contract
modification or migration of persistent official ~/.dsh user state
modification or upgrade of the Crew-owned DSH runtime/profile
installing npm @next or another prerelease dist-tag when @latest is available
validation: Before update, record the resolved official dsh executable/package version and npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh dist-tags --json plus npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest version --json.
Before update, record non-secret byte-size/SHA-256 integrity evidence for existing protected ~/.dsh files used by the official Harness, without printing file contents.
Update or reinstall the official @deepseek-ai/dsh CLI/runtime to npm @latest using the machine's working Node/npm toolchain; do not install @next.
After update, prove the installed official @deepseek-ai/dsh version exactly equals npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest version at execution time and record the resolved CLI path/source.
Start or restart the official Harness web profile and verify the official web service on port 3080 is healthy.
After update, recompute the same non-secret ~/.dsh integrity evidence and prove protected persistent official user state is byte-for-byte unchanged.

Verify the isolated dsh-crew installation/profile remains separate and unchanged; record its Crew-owned runtime version and Hub 3210 health if currently installed/running, but do not upgrade or reconfigure it.

Collect bounded release-audit metadata: npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest version, dependencies, peerDependencies and the installed top-level official DSH package version. Do not dump environment variables or package-manager auth config.
Run node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs result docs/agent-results/dsh-latest-runtime-audit-result.json --stamp and then final normal result validation.
acceptance_criteria: Official DeepSeek Harness CLI/runtime is installed at npm @latest at execution time, never @next unless npm itself has promoted it to @latest.
Official web Harness starts successfully and is healthy after the update.
Protected persistent ~/.dsh user state is unchanged by non-secret byte/hash comparison and no credential value is exposed or migrated.
Crew-owned isolated runtime/profile is not modified by this task.
The Result Contract contains enough bounded package/version metadata for ChatGPT to decide whether dsh-crew's existing Harness peer/dev constraints need release-prep changes.
Only the Result Contract is committed and ACTIVE_TASK.json is deleted on completion.
